one_liner: Zendesk offers a broad REST API for support, helpdesk, and messaging with OAuth2 and API token authentication.
gating_notes: A free 14-day trial is available for self-serve development. Marketplace partners can convert to a sponsored account.
oauth_details: OAuth access token authentication is supported, using the format 'Authorization: Bearer oauth_access_token'.

auth_methods.quote: To authenticate API requests, use basic authentication with your email address and password, your email address and an API token, or an OAuth access token

primary_auth.quote: If you use OAuth to authenticate, format the authorization header this way: Authorization: Bearer oauth_access_token

credential_access.quote: You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.

api_type.quote: Most of our APIs are organized by product capabilities. You'll find APIs for ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, sales CRM

api_breadth.quote: You'll find APIs for ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, sales CRM as well as some features that span capabilities
